problem_statement: Customer support teams have no structured way to collect and analyse post-resolution feedback, leading to missed service improvement opportunities.

requirements.text: Customers can submit a satisfaction rating (1–5) and free-text comment after a support ticket is resolved.
Support managers can view aggregated feedback scores and individual comments in a dashboard.
The system shall send a feedback request email to customers within 1 hour of ticket resolution.
